####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: This script generates SLURM shell script files (slurm.sh) for running R model 
fitting jobs in the cluster.

Functions Used:
- `fun_slurmsh.R`: Function to generate SLURM shell script to execute an R model fitting job.

Outputs: 
For each unipathogen, multi-unipathogen and multi-multipathogen (46), in the folder 
outputs/slurmsh:
- run_{pat}_brms_bm{doses}_{data}_{mod}.sh
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_slurmsh.R")

# Define the list of pathogens for which the scripts will be created
pat_l <- list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")) %>%
  str_subset("formula") %>%
  str_remove_all("formula_brms_|_l.rds")
```

# Loop over each pathogen in the defined list
```{r}
for (pathogen in pat_l) {
  ## Read the list of formulas specific to the current pathogen
  l_formula <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modfit}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))

  ## Identify model scripts that have already been executed
  ## List the files in the "runned" directory 
  already_runned <- str_remove(str_remove(list.files(glue("{dirs$outputs}/slurmsh/runned")), ".sh"),
                               glue("run_{pathogen}_brms_"))
  ## Filter out any formulas that have already been processed to avoid duplicate runs
  l_formula <- l_formula[!(names(l_formula) %in% already_runned)]
  
  ## For each remaining model in the formula list, generate the corresponding SLURM script
  walk(names(l_formula), function(args_fo) {
    # Determine the vaccine dose and data based on the model name
    vac <- case_when(str_detect(args_fo, "bmvl") ~ "vl",
                     str_detect(args_fo, "bmv3") ~ "v3",
                     str_detect(args_fo, "bmv2") ~ "v2",
                     str_detect(args_fo, "bmv1") ~ "v1")
    dfk <- case_when(str_detect(args_fo, "dfkgc1") ~ "_kgc_1",
                     str_detect(args_fo, "dfkgc2") ~ "_kgc_2",
                     str_detect(args_fo, "dfkgc3") ~ "_kgc_3",
                     TRUE ~ "")
    # Set the number of iterations for the SLURM job:
    # For 'multi_strep', use 5000 iterations; for all others, default to 10000 iterations.
    args_iter <- case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_strep10") ~ 5000, 
                           pathogen == "multi_pertua" ~ 7000, 
                           .default = 10000)
    dat_name <- case_when(
      str_detect(args_fo, "seonlytemp") ~ glue("dataseonlytemp_brms_{pathogen}_{vac}_s08{dfk}.rds"), 
      str_detect(args_fo, "semeth") ~ glue("datasemeth_brms_{pathogen}_{vac}_s08{dfk}.rds"),
      str_detect(args_fo, "seonlyseropos") ~ glue("dataseonlyseropos_brms_{pathogen}_{vac}_s08{dfk}.rds"),
      str_detect(args_fo, "seallsero") ~ glue("dataseallsero_brms_{pathogen}_{vac}_s08{dfk}.rds"),
      str_detect(args_fo, "sebirth") ~ glue("data_brms_{pathogen}_{vac}_s08{dfk}.rds"),
      str_detect(args_fo, "sesplines") ~ glue("data_brms_{pathogen}_{vac}_s08{dfk}.rds"),
      .default = glue("data_brms_{pathogen}_{vac}_s08{dfk}.rds"))
    
    # Generate the SLURM shell script file 
    fun_slurmsh(args_fo = args_fo, args_iter = args_iter, dat_name = dat_name, pathogen = pathogen, 
                time = "24:00:00")
  })
}  
```

# List cluster run commands
```{r}
# For each generated SLURM script, print the sbatch command needed to submit the job
for (i in str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$outputs}/slurmsh")), "seonlytemp|semeth|seonlyseropos|seallsero|sebirth",
                     negate = TRUE)) {
  print(glue("sbatch ~/projects/_seas_imm/runsh/{i}"))
}

for (i in str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$outputs}/slurmsh")), "semeth")) {
  print(glue("sbatch ~/projects/_seas_imm/runsh/{i}"))
}
```
